<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['hash']))
    return sorted(out)
before=snap(current_frame)
res=action(['RIGHT','RIGHT'], intent='explore')
after=snap(current_frame)
print("changed:", before!=after)
print("RESULT:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
# show red/green/blue nodes before/after
for tag,s in (('BEFORE',before),('AFTER',after)):
    print(tag, [x for x in s if x[0] in ('R','N','b','B','r','Y')])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

import json
def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],(r0,c0,r1,c1),n['hash']))
    return sorted(out)
before=snap(current_frame)
